products.title: Riiffs Momento Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Momento Extrait de Parfum is a new unisex scent launched in 2025. Riiffs Momento Extrait de Parfum is a warm, sweet and woody fragrance with a little spicy touch. The scent opens with sugar, saffron and fresh mandarin, giving a sweet and slightly citrus start. In the middle, you get soft tonka bean, romantic Damask rose and creamy agarwood. The base is deep and smooth with amberwood, caramel and cedar, which gives a creamy, woody drydown.

products.title: Lattafa Badee al Oud Honor & Glory Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Badee Al Oud Honor & Glory Eau de Parfum is a unisex Arabic perfume that combines creamy, spicy and woody notes into one smooth scent. The opening is a delightful combination of pineapple and creme brulee, which feels both sweet and warm. When it settles down, the middle reveals the spices of cinnamon, turmeric, black pepper, and the sweetness of benzoin, making a heart that is both spicy and cozy. The dry-down is soft and rich with the notes of vanilla, sandalwood, cashmeran, and moss, which give the perfume a permanent warmth.

products.title: Lattafa Bade'e Al Oud Oud for Glory Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Bade’e Al Oud Oud for Glory Eau De Parfum is a strong and deep Arabic perfume made for both men and women who love rich oud scents. It starts with spicy and warm notes of saffron, nutmeg, and lavender, which make the fragrance bold right from the beginning. The main part of the perfume features soft patchouli and burnt agarwood (oud) giving the scent a dark and classy character. At last, the base of agarwood, patchouli, and musk come together in a very organic way, leaving behind a warm and long-lasting scent trail.

products.title: Lattafa Vintage Radio Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Vintage Radio Eau de Parfum is an unisex scent that can be characterized as warm oriental-woody with an opening that is soft, smoky and fresh. It starts with lavender, sage, and bergamot on the top, goes into a dark and sweet mixture of plum, palo santo, and black pepper in the heart and finishes with a smooth base of sandalwood and oud.

products.title: Nusuk Al Mukhtalif Signature Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Nusuk Al Mukhtalif Signature Extrait de Parfum is a decadent and bold men’s fragrance from the house of Nusuk. Released in 2024, it brings a deep woody aromatic scent style with a strong Middle Eastern touch. The scent opens with a powerful mix of oud, sandalwood, rose, amber, bergamot, neroli and jasmine, which feels warm and slightly fresh at the same time. The middle blends agarwood, patchouli, cedar, lemon, rose and jasmine, giving it a woody floral depth. The base settles into smooth oud, musk and vanilla, leaving a soft, sweet, woody trail that feels classy and long lasting.

products.title: Khadlaj Cloud Candy Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Khadlaj Cloud Candy Eau de Parfum is a sweet, creamy perfume by Khadlaj Perfumes, targeted at both men and women. It is released in 2025 and provides a soft, candy-like touch with a warm and cosy feel. Cloud Candy begins on a sweet and light note that is almost fluffy, as though sugar is melting in the air. 


The heart becomes creamier and smoother after a couple of minutes, which resembles the sensation of a candy shop. When it fades, it becomes warmer and softer, keeping close to the skin in a warm and cosy sweetness. It is light-hearted, light, and somewhat addictive and is ideal for those who enjoy sweet smells that are not heavy but are easy to detect.

products.title: Rayhaan Obsidian Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Rayhaan Obsidian Eau De Parfum is a bold and dark woody perfume for men who like strong yet smooth scents. It opens with soft iris and fresh citrus notes, giving a clean, slightly powdery start. As the scent settles, the leather note comes forward, giving a deep, masculine feel. In the drydown, warm notes of sandalwood, ambrette, cedar and oud create a creamy, woody base that feels elegant and long lasting. Rayhaan Obsidian is simple but powerful, a fragrance that suits modern men who enjoy warm, woody and leathery scents.

products.title: Riiffs Golden Elixir Reserve Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Golden Elixir Reserve Eau de Parfum is a creamy and warm unisex perfume from Riiffs Perfumes. Launched in 2024, it is a sweet, spicy scent profile built with cinnamon, cognac, cardamom and coffee in the opening; praline, dates and tonka bean in the heart and a deep base of vanilla, agarwood and musk.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Bin Shaikh Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html:
Ahmed Al Maghribi Bin Shaikh Eau de Parfum is an elegant oriental fragrance for both men and women. Inspired by rich Arabic traditions and royal gatherings, this scent wraps you in warmth, sweetness, and a soft floral touch.

Bin Shaikh combines the beauty of fresh roses, exotic saffron, and earthy oak moss with a sweet heart of bakhoor, sugar, jasmine, and violet. The dry down is deep and comforting with oud, amber, ambroxan, musk, and patchouli creating a luxurious trail.

Ahmed Al Maghribi Bin Shaikh Eau de Parfum is perfect for those who love sweet, woody scents with a hint of floral freshness. Just a few sprays make you feel confident, royal, and ready for any special moment.

products.title: Ibraheem Al Qurashi Blue Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Blue Oud Eau de Parfum is a deep and strong fragrance that combines rich oud with soft floral notes. It starts with a smooth combination of oud and blue lilies, giving a fresh yet dark feeling. The middle becomes warm with leather and patchouli, adding a bold touch. In the last, you get sweet amber and smoky tobacco, which make the scent feel cosy, elegant, and long-lasting. It is a beautiful combination of luxury and softness, suitable for both men and women.

products.title: Lattafa Qaeed Al Fursan Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Qaeed Al Fursan Eau de Parfum is a rich, warm and bold unisex perfume. It has a deep oriental-woody feel with a sweet top and smoky base. The scent opens with pineapple and saffron, then moves into balsam fir and soft jasmine in the heart. The dry-down is thick, warm and long-lasting with cedar, amber and oud.

products.title: Afnan Rare Carbon Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Afnan Rare Carbon Eau de Parfum is a bold leather perfume for men launched in 2020 by the house of Afnan Perfumes. It carries a strong masculine edge with an elegant combination of spicy, floral, woody and smoky accords. The opening is sharp and intense with leather, violet leaf, nutmeg and cinnamon. The middle brings floral tones of violet and rose combined with deep oud and cedar wood. The dry down is warm, earthy and rich with vetiver, sandalwood and amber giving it a timeless Arabic touch.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Blu Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ahmed Al Maghribi Blue Oud Eau de Parfum is a unisex signature perfume from the house of Ahmed Al Maghribi Fragrances. Launched in 2024, it is a bold take on a fresh and woody DNA profile consisting of leather, bergamot, and cypress (top notes); geranium and violet leaf (heart notes); and agarwood, patchouli, and musk (base notes) mixed seamlessly into a smooth composition with classic Middle Eastern accords of oud, incense, and guaiac wood.

products.title: Louis Vuitton Ombre Nomade Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Louis Vuitton Ombre Nomade Eau De Parfum is a dark, rich and deep unisex perfume. It is known for its strong oud, smoky incense and warm amber wood feel that stays long on the skin. The scent opens with a mix of sweet raspberry and saffron, then melts into rose and smoky incense and finally settles into heavy agarwood that gives a strong touch.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Marj Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ahmed Al Maghribi Marj Eau de Parfum is a unisex floriental fragrance by the Ahmed Al Maghribi fragrance house launched in 2023. It is a beautiful and graceful balance of numerous scent notes, which could have given messy results without fine blending. Marj has oud, honey, pink pepper, elemi, nutmeg, bergamot, and mandarin for its top layer; jasmine, cashmere wood, vetiver, orange blossom, cinnamon, patchouli, and saffron for the heart; and musk, ambergris, raspberry, oakmoss, saffron, pear, amber, agarwood, sandalwood, leather, and violet for the base of the composition.

products.title: Tom Ford Oud Wood Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Tom Ford Oud Wood Eau De Parfum is an exquisite and elegant unisex fragrance that has a woody character. It is warm and soft, and very luxurious, right from the first application. The fragrance starts off with delicate spices and rosewood that are both clean and rich. Gradually, the oud and sandalwood appear, creating a profound woody sensation. During the dry down, tonka bean and amber provide a gentle and prolonged sweetness. This perfume feels luxurious, serene, and self-assured, ideal for the customers of high-end fragrances.

products.title: Lattafa Bade'e Al Oud Amethyst Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Bade’e Al Oud Amethyst Eau de Parfum is a unisex fragrance with a smooth and elegant oriental vanilla scent. Launched in 2021, it opens with fresh and spicy top notes of pink pepper and bergamot, followed by the floral heart of Turkish rose, Bulgarian rose, and jasmine. The base is rich and warm with agarwood (oud), amber, and vanilla.

products.title: Lattafa Qaeed Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Qaeed Eau De Parfum is a creamy, warm and bold unisex perfume from the house of Lattafa. It has a strong oriental style with sweet spices, deep woods, soft leather and smoky oud. The opening is spicy with cinnamon, cardamom, and bergamot. The heart has saffron, sandalwood, cedar and carnation, giving a warm and creamy feel. The dry down becomes sweet, woody and slightly smoky with oud, vanilla, leather and amber.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Mahad Al Dahab Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Mahad Al Dahab Eau de Parfum is a creamy and warm unisex perfume made for people who love deep oriental scents. Launched in 2025, this fragrance feels luxurious and strong but still smooth. It opens with fresh citrus and spicy notes, then slowly moves into a warm heart of amber, patchouli and oud. The dry down is creamy and soft with vanilla, sandalwood and white musk, which stays close to skin and feels very elegant.

products.title: Mancera Red Tobacco Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Mancera Red Tobacco Eau De Parfum is a bold and heavy unisex scent known for its rich, smoky and sweet spicy style. It starts loud with warm cinnamon, oud, incense, saffron, nutmeg and some fruity green apple and pear. Then it melts into a simple heart of patchouli and jasmine. The dry down comes strong with thick tobacco, sweet vanilla, amber, sandalwood, guaiac wood, white musk and vetiver.

products.title: Rasasi Shuhrah Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Rasasi Shuhrah Eau de Parfum is a strong and classy fragrance for the modern man. The fragrance begins with the very lively and vibrant top notes of tomato leaf, rose and freesia. It then transforms into a floral and woody heart of rose, sandalwood, cedar and jasmine. Finally, it wraps up with a base that provides a rich and warm finish through the combination of leather, oud, musk, oakmoss and amber.

products.title: Rayhaan Corium Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rayhaan Corium Eau de Parfum is a bold, masculine scent. Rayhaan Corium Eau de Parfum was released in 2023 and carries a dark, warm profile built around chestnut, spices and elemi in the opening; aromatic sage in the middle and a deep base of vanilla, leather and oud. The mixture feels creamy, slightly sweet and smoky with a strong leather tone that gives a classy yet powerful vibe.

products.title: Lattafa Badee Al Oud Sublime Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Badee Al Oud Sublime Eau de Parfum is a modern unisex scent from the house of Lattafa Perfumes. It combines fresh, floral and woody notes that are very pleasant and have a long-lasting effect at the same time. The perfume starts with fruity and soft floral notes of apple, litchi and rose, which make a sweet and bright opening. As it develops, the heart reveals plum and jasmine that add a creamy floral depth. The base brings warm notes of moss, vanilla and patchouli, leaving a rich, elegant trail that remains for hours.

products.title: Swiss Arabian Shagaf Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Swiss Arabian Shaghaf Oud Eau de Parfum is a rich and bold unisex perfume from the house of Swiss Arabian. The perfume has a very deep Middle Eastern oud style with a slight and soft sweet note. The opening of the fragrance is that of warm saffron, then the main note of strong oud and rose takes over and finally a very rich and creamy base of praline, vanilla and oud.

products.title: Lattafa Velvet Oud Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Velvet Oud Eau De Parfum is a deep, warm and bold unisex scent from the house of Lattafa. It mixes smoky incense, rich leather, strong oud, warm amber and soft musk into a thick, dark cloud of sweet, smoky woods. The scent opens with a hint of citrus that feels bright for a few seconds but quickly melts into spicy cinnamon, heavy oud, and warm amber. It is known for its dark and powerful aura, making it a perfect pick for people who love strong Arabic-style perfumes.

products.title: French Avenue Azzure Aoud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Azzure Aoud Eau de Parfum is a strong and dominant perfume for men with warm, fruity, and deep notes. The introduction is a pleasant fruity mix that is infused with rose and saffron to produce a smooth but slightly spicy taste. The robust oud evolves over time with patchouli and benzoin in order to establish a complex, dark atmosphere. The bottom part of the combines leather and wood materials with soft fabrics and creates a long-lasting and powerful smell that comprises vanilla and amber.

products.title: Al Haramain Amber Oud Aqua Dubai Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Al Haramain Amber Oud Aqua Dubai Eau de Parfum is a fresh and vibrant unisex perfume. It mixes fruity, green and warm amber notes to create a modern everyday scent. The opening feels juicy and bright with bergamot, green notes and mandarin orange. The heart becomes sweet and tropical with melon, black currant and pineapple mixed with smooth amber. The base is soft and creamy with musk, petitgrain, galbanum and vanilla, giving a long lasting finish.

products.title: Dunhill Icon Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Dunhill Icon Eau de Parfum is a classy and timeless perfume for men that combines modern freshness with warm woods. Launched in 2015, it brings together citrusy top notes of neroli and bergamot, followed by a spicy core of black pepper, lavender and cardamom. The base is creamy and masculine with vetiver, oakmoss, leather, iris and oud. It’s a perfume that wraps around you a feeling of elegance, confidence and being dressed up throughout the day.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Summer Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ahmed Al Maghribi Summer Oud Eau de Parfum is a unisex fragrance from Ahmed Al Maghribi Fragrances. Launched in 2022, it is a refreshing and warm scent with a perfect summer vibe. The scent has a bright and fresh opening formed by the very top notes of saffron, mandarin orange, incense and cypriol. The fragrance then gets warmer and sweeter thanks to the middle notes of rose, cashmere wood, caramel, amber and patchouli. The skin is then treated with a long lasting, rich and smooth trail created by the base of oud, leather, musk, oakmoss and vetiver.

products.title: Mancera  Cedrat Boise Intense Extrait De Parfum
products.body_html: Mancera Cedrat Boise Intense Extrait de Parfum is a deeper, more decadent version of the original Cedrat Boise. This Mancera Cedrat Boise Intense Extrait de Parfum feels bolder, smoother and more long lasting on the skin. It starts with fresh citrus aromas, blended with black currant and spice, for a sharp, classy opening. Leather, sandalwood, oud, patchouli and jasmine all intertwine and combine to form a warm, rather smoky heart as it settles. It is creamy, musky at the base, contains ambergris, oakmoss, vanilla and white musk and lasts hours and hours on the skin.

products.title: Ajmal Cyan Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ajmal Cyan Oud Eau de Parfum is the Dubai-based house's fruity-musky take on Xerjoff's Erba Pura. Bright citrus up front, a juicy mango-peach middle, and a clean vanilla-musk landing. Despite the name, there is no oud here. Light, sweet, and easy to wear, it feels more like a fruit bowl than a prayer hall. Built for Indian summers, office hours, and casual daytime.

products.title: Lattafa Mashrabya Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Mashrabya Eau de Parfum is a hot and sweet unisex perfume, which is deep and somewhat smoky. It starts by flavouring a fruity apple shisha touch blended with soft pink pepper, which is a very sweet beginning but a little spicy. Tobacco, cinnamon and dates are used in the middle to form a very rich and warm feel. The oud smoke, caramel, vanilla and patchouli base make it smooth, dark and long-lasting. It is daring, contemporary and fits better in cooler seasons.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Hypnotic Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Hypnotic Oud Eau de Parfum is a rich and bold unisex perfume made for oud lovers. This scent opens with spicy and floral notes that feel warm and slightly sweet. As it settles, the deep oud mixes with caramel and soft woody tones, giving a smooth and addictive feel. The base is creamy and warm with vanilla and amber, which makes the fragrance feel cozy and long lasting.

products.title: Lattafa Oud Mood Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Oud Mood Eau De Parfum is a warm, rich and deep unisex perfume from the well-known house of Lattafa. It has a strong Middle Eastern touch with spicy, sweet and woody notes. The scent opens with a soft mix of rose, saffron and a little peppery pimento. In the middle, you get caramel, floral notes, patchouli and a beautiful oud tone that gives a dark and sweet feel. The dry down is warm with amber, resins, musk, incense and woody notes that stay long on skin and clothes.

products.title: Franck Olivier Oud Vanille Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Franck Olivier Oud Vanille Eau De Parfum is a warm, deep, and cozy smell. It feels rich right from the start. It mixes the smooth sweet of caramel and raspberry with a little fresh orange. This makes a creamy, nice opening. As it sits, the perfume infuses more. You get a flowery smell of rose, violet, and jasmine. This is mixed with patchouli and a bit of incense. It gives a soft, smoky, and mysterious feel. It is creamy, cozy, and a little spicy. It rests nicely on wood, musk, and spice smells. 

Franck Olivier Oud Vanille is the kind of scent that makes you feel wrapped up in luxury. It is not too loud. But people will notice you when you walk past. It is perfect for evenings or cold days. It leaves a sweet, deep smell that stays softly. This perfume is good for both men and women. It balances sweet, spice, and sexy smells well. It is not too strong.

products.title: Riiffs Areebah Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Areebah Eau de Parfum is a new unisex perfume from the house of Riiffs Perfumes. It is a creamy, oriental, woody scent that feels warm, sweet and a little exotic at the same time. The scent opens with fruity and spicy tones of tropical fruits, osmanthus and saffron. The middle notes include patchouli, frangipani and agarwood, which impart a creamy, woody feel. In the dry down, you get cedar, musk and Madagascar vanilla, which makes the fragrance smooth, soft and long lasting with a cozy trail.

products.title: Riiffs Exotic Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Exotic Oud Eau de Parfum is a bold leather fragrance for men who like strong and dark scents. Launched in 2022, this perfume opens with soft floral and warm notes of geranium, amber and iris. After a few minutes, the heart comes with spicy cinnamon and a fresh citrus touch. The base is deep and smoky with leather, tobacco, spices, smoke and woody notes. Riiffs Exotic Oud Eau de Parfum feels creamy, warm and slightly sweet in the drydown.

products.title: Swiss Arabian Shagaf Oud Tonka Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Swiss Arabian Shagaf Oud Tonka Eau de Parfum is a rich, warm and sweet unisex fragrance made for people who enjoy deep gourmand scents. The opening is slightly sweet with a creamy feeling coming from the soft, nutty almond note. Then, the floral notes of the Tunisian orange blossom and Turkish rose come together with the warm cinnamon in a smooth and cozy heart of the fragrance. The dry down is where the magic stays, with tonka bean, vanilla and amberwood creating a long lasting, addictive scent trail.

products.title: Swiss Arabian Oud Azraq Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Swiss Arabian Oud Azraq Eau de Parfum is a rich and deep unisex fragrance made for people who enjoy bold oud scents with sweetness. It opens with a smooth honey note merged with dark agarwood, giving a warm and slightly sweet start. The middle contains spicy cinnamon entwined with rich, creamy vanilla and amber, which is pleasant and comforting. The base comprises patchouli and leather, creating a strong, staying Middle Eastern aura. It feels luxurious, warm and powerful, but still wearable.

products.title: Chopard Oud Malaki Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Chopard Oud Malaki Eau De Parfum is a bold men’s fragrance that combines smoky woods, leather, and spices with a warm and deep oud base. This scent shows true luxury and elegance, made for men who love strong and royal perfumes. It starts fresh with grapefruit and lavender, turns deep with tobacco and leather, and finally settles into a base of oud, ambergris, and dark woods that gives a classy and long-lasting scent trail.

products.title: Ajmal  Eau d'Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ajmal Eau d'Oud Eau de Parfum is a modern unisex fragrance made for people who like fresh notes with a deep oud base. It opens with a clean and fresh mix of citrus, bergamot and mint, which feels bright and energetic. The middle is formed of the gentle flowers and the warm spices of such as neroli, ginger, rose and nutmeg that give it a smooth balance. The base settles into a creamy combination of oud, amber, musk and tonka bean, thus imparting warmth, comfort and longevity to the fragrance.

products.title: French Avenue Coco Morado Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Coco Morado Eau de Parfum is a bold and deep unisex fragrance for those who enjoy dark, sweet and woody scents. It opens with spicy warmth from cinnamon, saffron, nutmeg and ginger, which feels creamy and slightly sharp at first. As the perfume settles, you start getting heavy oud, incense, dates, caramel and amberwood notes that feel sweet, smoky and resin like. In the dry down, leather, vanilla, cacao butter, musk and patchouli come together to give a creamy, warm and long lasting base that feels luxurious and strong.

products.title: Riiffs Goodness Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Goodness Oud Eau de Parfum is a bold, deep oriental woody perfume for men who like a strong presence. It opens with spicy, fresh notes of pink pepper, clary sage and saffron. The middle brings smooth ambroxan and dry cedar wood, which gives it a clean woody feel. The base is warm and long lasting with white musk, patchouli, amber and guaiac wood.

products.title: Paco Rabanne One Million Golden Oud Parfum
products.body_html: Paco Rabanne One Million Golden Oud Parfum is a prosperous and bold men's perfume from the house of Rabanne. It launched in 2023 and is a deep, warm scent made with spicy, woody and leathery notes that feel royal and strong. It begins spicy and fresh using saffron, nutmeg, black pepper and bergamot. The middle is a smooth mixture of woody patchouli, gurjan balsam and sandalwood. The base is dark, warm and long lasting, using oud, leather, cedarwood and labdanum.

products.title: Ajmal Aristocrat Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ajmal Aristocrat Eau De Parfum was launched in 2017 by Ajmal fragrance house based in UAE as a woody floral musk scent with a citric opening and a musky drydown. Alongside the zesty lime and bergamot notes, the opening is adorned with melon sweetness, the heart speaks of floral lily and jasmine while dancing in a musk wind; and the drydown is like a sunset- soft and satisfying with pleasant woody notes of amber, oud patchouli and cedar.

products.title: Maison Crivelli Oud Maracuja Extrait De Parfum
products.body_html: Maison Crivelli Oud Maracuja Extrait De Parfum is a bold and unique fragrance launched in 2023. It is made for both women and men who like something different and strong. The scent opens with a mix of passionfruit and saffron, giving a fruity yet slightly spicy feel. Then oud and patchouli come in, adding depth and richness. In the dry down, leather, amber and vanilla create a dark, warm and long-lasting finish that stays close but noticeable.

products.title: Al Haramain Amber Oud Dubai Night Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Al Haramain Amber Oud Dubai Night Extrait de Parfum is a rich and warm scent made for men who like deep and classy fragrances. It is a new release from the famous Al Haramain house in 2024. The perfume opens with spicy saffron, fresh bergamot and soft elemi. The heart carries strong agarwood with elegant Bulgarian rose and gentle lily of the valley. The base settles into sweet tonka bean, warm amber, clean white musk and earthy oakmoss.

products.title: Montale Arabians Tonka Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Montale Arabians Tonka Eau de Parfum is a warm, rich and sweet oriental scent made for both men and women. It combines bold spices with deep woods and smooth sweetness. The very beginning gives us saffron and bergamot, which form a brilliant start with a bit of spice. The heart is, of course, very powerful with oud and Bulgarian rose. Finally, the dry down is very warm and cozy with tonka bean, sugar cane, amber, white musk and oakmoss.

products.title: Afnan Supremacy in Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Afnan Supremacy in Oud Eau de Parfum is a warm, bold, and luxurious unisex fragrance that blends rich spices with smooth oud and sweet undertones. Launched in 2021, Supremacy in Oud quickly became popular for its exotic vibe and modern twist on classic oriental scents.

The first spray of Afnan Supremacy in Oud Eau de Parfum brings a burst of spicy saffron and nutmeg, balanced with calming lavender. The heart reveals deep agarwood (oud) mixed with sweet notes that add a smooth, comforting layer. The dry down is warm and long-lasting with earthy patchouli and soft musk, giving this perfume a rich, lasting finish.

Afnan Supremacy in Oud Eau de Parfum is perfect for people who love powerful, spicy, and woody scents that make them stand out wherever they go.

products.title: Gucci Intense Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Gucci Intense Oud Eau de Parfum is an oriental fragrance available for women and men. It was released in 2016 and developed by perfumer Aurélien Guichard. This fragrance begins with the notes of frankincense, raspberry, saffron and pear that are a bombard of smoky and sweet sweetness. Damask rose, musk and orange blossom, agarwood (oud) and leather with patchouli and ambergris are reported to be the damask rose, the base, and the other, respectively. It is courageous, intense and highly opulent to the skin.

products.title: French Avenue Aromatix X Carnal Desire Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Aromatix X Carnal Desire Extrait de Parfum is a powerful and enticing perfume that is suitable for women and men to use. It starts off with a sweet, fruity raspberry smell that is mixed with fresh bergamot and light cinnamon spice. The aroma becomes sweet, creamy and comprises cotton candy, soft rose, and powdery orris. The dry down has a thick, dense fragrance that mixes leather, oud, vanilla, and wood notes that last long after application in the skin.

products.title: Ajmal Wisal Layl Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ajmal Wisal Layl Eau de Parfum is a rich and elegant unisex fragrance from the house of Ajmal. It is a soft yet deep floral scent with a warm oriental touch. The perfume opens with sweet fruity notes of blackcurrant and apricot mixed with fresh freesia. A beautiful rose with patchouli and gentle osmanthus flowers is felt in the middle of the perfume. The base is warm and very long lasting, with musk, oud and frankincense giving it an Arabic, luxurious feel.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Lutfah The Seventh Heaven Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Lutfah The Seventh Heaven Eau de Parfum is a modern unisex perfume. Launched in 2024, this fragrance feels rich, warm and slightly spicy with a deep Arabic touch. It opens with a fresh spicy mix of pink pepper, bright Sicilian bergamot and sweet davana that feels uplifting and classy. The heart is warm and resinous with white amber, agarwood and herbal rosemary, giving a calm but powerful feel. The base is deep and long lasting with leather, earthy Haitian vetiver, and soft musk that stays on skin for hours and feels luxurious.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Kawkab Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ahmed Al Maghribi Kawkab Eau de Parfum is a rich and modern unisex perfume with a strong oriental touch. It starts with a fruity and spicy mixture of mango, saffron, citrus and soft florals that are bright but warm at the same time. The middle note is amber, rose, iris and black tea that are smooth and slightly smoky. The base is deep, woody and very long lasting with oud, tonka bean, patchouli, musk and cedar, which gives it a bold and classy finish that feels lavish but is still easy to wear.

products.title: French Avenue Opus Magnum Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Opus Magnum Extrait de Parfum is a deep, creamy and bold unisex fragrance. Launched in 2025, this perfume opens with a smoky, spicy touch of incense and cardamom mixed with fresh basil and bergamot. As it settles, the middle brings warm tobacco, soft lavender and a slightly bitter note of fenugreek that gives it a unique twist. The base is heavy, warm and long lasting with Peru balsam, oud, amber and tonka bean, making the scent feel smooth, dark and comforting.

products.title: Ard Al Zaafaran Dirham Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Ard Al Zaafaran Dirham Oud Eau De Parfum special fragrance is perfect for both men and women who love a warm, woody scent with a touch of elegance. Dirham Oud is a beautiful combination of fresh notes and deep, earthy tones, creating a perfume that feels both modern and classic.

This fragrance is a journey for your senses. It starts with a bright and zesty burst of fruits, then moves to a soft floral heart, and finally settles into a powerful, lasting base of woods and oud. It's a scent that makes you feel confident and sophisticated, perfect for any occasion where you want to make a statement.

products.title: Lattafa Art of Nature 1 Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Art of Nature Eau de Parfum is a luxurious unisex scent that blends the magic of nature with rich oriental notes. Launched in 2024, this perfume carries the freshness of fruits and the depth of woody warmth. It starts with figs, plums, and blackcurrants, which are of the best quality and then very slowly dissolve into the gentle center of leather, rhubarb, and rose. The base holds deep oud, smooth ambergris, and creamy vanilla, leaving an elegant and long-lasting trail on your skin.

products.title: Paris Corner Khair Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Paris Corner Khair Eau de Parfum is a modern unisex fragrance. Launched in 2023, it carries a warm oriental woody scent profile that blends fruity herbal freshness with deep woody richness. The opening starts with davana, bergamot and pink pepper, giving a slightly sweet spicy feel. The heart unfolds into creamy agarwood, oud, amber and rosemary that create a warm aromatic body. The base settles into leather, vetiver and musk, which adds depth, softness and a long lasting trail. The blend feels smooth, bold and balanced with a classy Middle Eastern touch.

products.title: Riiffs Goodness Oud Rouge Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Goodness Oud Rouge by Riiffs Perfumes is a fragrance for women. This is a new fragrance. Goodness Oud Rouge was launched in 2023. Top notes are Mango and Bergamot; middle notes are Olibanum and Jasmine; base notes are Vanilla and Sandalwood.

products.title: Lattafa Ra'ed Silver Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Ra’ed Silver Eau de Parfum is a warm and spicy unisex scent with a bright citrus opening and a deep, sweet, woody base. It starts with fresh hints of citruses, spices and mandarin orange, then moves into a rich heart of cinnamon, saffron, amber and cloves. The base settles into soft vanilla, musk, leather, oud and a touch of ambergris.

products.title: Rayhaan Wood Noir Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rayhaan Wood Noir Eau de Parfum is a dark, woody scent for men who like warm, spicy, smooth perfumes. It opens with spicy cardamom and sharp Sichuan pepper, which gives a fresh heat at the start. The heart features creamy woods like sandalwood, oud and vetiver, which give the scent depth and class. In drydown, creamy tonka bean, amber and vanilla mix together and create a soft, sweet, warm trail.

products.title: Al Haramain Amber Oud Bleu Edition Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Al Haramain Amber Oud Bleu Edition Eau de Parfum is a fresh and elegant unisex perfume from Al Haramain Perfumes. This scent brings a clean citrus start with spicy and woody heart and a deep, warm base. The opening gives fresh grapefruit, lemon, mint and pink pepper. The middle note is dominated by ginger vetiver jasmine that contributes soft spice and a floral accent. The base is composed of olibanum, sandalwood, cedar and patchouli, which make it creamy, smooth and long lasting.

products.title: Al Haramain Amber Oud Carbon Edition Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Al Haramain Amber Oud Carbon Edition Eau de Parfum is a fresh and bold unisex perfume. This scent gives a clean, airy and modern feel with a mix of citrus, herbs and woody notes. It opens with bright bergamot, calming lavender and rosemary. The heart brings sea notes with geranium and sage, giving a cool ocean touch. The base is warm and earthy with moss, amber, vetiver and cedar.

products.title: Kayali Invite Only Amber 23 Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Kayali Invite Only Amber 23 Eau De Parfum is a creamy, sweet and spicy perfume that feels bold and deep. It opens with a mix of cherry, honey and chocolate that offers a warm, slightly sweet start. As it settles, soft rose and cinnamon notes come out, delivering a smooth floral and spicy feel. In the dry down, it becomes dark, warm and woody, with notes of amber, oud and vanilla, making it long lasting and very addictive.

This fragrance is made for people who love deep, sweet and spicy tobacco style scents. It opens with strong notes of tobacco leaf, cinnamon, black pepper and ginger, which feel spicy and cozy at the same time. The heart is creamy and sweet with vanilla, cloves, star anise, tonka bean, cacao and incense, giving it a smooth, addictive feel. The base settles into tobacco dried fruits and woody notes that feel warm, luxurious and long lasting on skin.

products.title: Riiffs Goodness Oud Blanc Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Goodness Oud Blanc Eau de Parfum is a soft, sweet, oriental floral scent for both men and women. It opens with a romantic Damask rose and a creamy praline note that gives a sweet feel from the start. The middle features sugar, white musk and jasmine sambac, making the scent smooth, light, floral and cozy. Drydown has amber xtreme, vanilla and patchouli, giving a warm, long lasting base with a slightly sweet, woody touch.

products.title: Penhaligon's Halfeti Leather Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Penhaligon's Halfeti Leather Eau de Parfum is a powerful and mysterious leather scent that is unisex. The fragrance begins with a delicate combination of plum, cardamom, and fresh citrus that is warm and somewhat spicy. Gradually, rose, nutmeg, and cinnamon unfold revealing a profound and elegant character. At the end of the process, leather, oud, and incense remain robust and smoky. The impression received from this fragrance is dauntless, sumptuous and just right for self-assured perfume users.

products.title: Lattafa Oud Mood Reminiscence Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Oud Mood Reminiscence Eau De Parfum is a warm oriental scent with a bright fruity opening and a smooth woody base. It starts with fresh notes of bergamot, apple and pineapple that feel clean and juicy. Then rose, birch, patchouli and Moroccan jasmine delight you with a floral & smoky quality. Finally, musk, oakmoss, vanilla, and ambergris create a warm soft cloud that remains on the skin like a cozy and gentle hug.

products.title: Rasasi La Yuqawam Tobacco Blaze Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rasasi La Yuqawam Tobacco Blaze Eau De Parfum is a daring and dark oriental men’s perfume for those who appreciate strong and profound scents. It starts with a combination of spicy saffron, fresh neroli and light floral notes. As it settles, you can smell sweet apricot, warm amber and woody cedar that gives it richness. The final stage of the fragrance is very powerful and manly with leather, oud and patchouli that give the impression of being smoky, warm and powerful.

products.title: Swiss Arabian Shagaf Oud Royal Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Swiss Arabian Shaghaf Oud Royal Eau de Parfum is a unisex scent that brings together the luxuriousness of oud and warm, spicy fragrances. Launched in 2023, it starts with a note of glamorous saffron and fresh lavender, then a heart of strong oud and nutmeg, all resting on an attractive base of patchouli and musk.

products.title: Kayali Oudgasm Vanilla Oud 36 Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Kayali Oudgasm Vanilla Oud 36 Eau De Parfum is a creamy, sweet and deep oud based fragrance for both men and women. It comes with a smooth mix of sugary vanilla, soft florals and strong woody oud. The scent opens a little sweet and spicy, then slowly turns creamy and warm on the skin. The combination of praline, pear and rose makes it soft, while oud and musk give it depth and a long lasting feel.

products.body_html: Louis Vuitton Nuit de Feu Eau De Parfum is a deep and smoky unisex scent that feels warm, dark and very rich. products.title: Neesh Luxe Hayat Extrait De Parfum
products.body_html: Neesh Luxe Hayat Extrait De Parfum is a rich and elegant unisex perfume. Launched in 2024, this fragrance feels modern but also very classic at heart. The scent opens up with fresh citrus notes combined with soft neroli, which makes the start very clean and bright. The floral notes of rose, jasmine and orris together with patchouli are revealed as the scent develops, and they impart warmth and depth to the fragrance. The soft and slightly sweet base consists of white chocolate, vanilla, oud and sandalwood, which creates a feel of luxury that is also very lasting. It smells premium, comforting and confident.

products.title: Lattafa Oud Mood Elixir Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Oud Mood Elixir Eau De Parfum is a warm and deep scent for Men and Women that mixes spicy, sweet and woody notes in a very smooth way. It opens with saffron, nutmeg and a touch of cinnamon that feels rich and spicy. The center note becomes a combination of oud, suede and sandalwood, which is soft, smoky and creamy and thus gives the fragrance a quite pleasant character. The amber and vanilla mix forming the dry-down is not only sweet but warm as well, and this base stays on skin for long hours.

products.title: Franck Olivier Oud Touch Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Franck Olivier Oud Touch Eau De Parfum is very deep and rich. It feels warm, kinda Middle Eastern. It is fancy and bold. They made Oud Touch in 2014. It starts sweet. You smell caramel, raspberry, and orange. This is a smooth, little fruity start. Next, you smell flowers and earth. That is rose, jasmine, and patchouli. This mixes well with the last smells. Those are amber, vanilla, and musk. Franck Olivier Oud Touch is for guys who want a smell that is strong and stays a long time. Oud Touch is nice but easy to wear. It is best for nighttime or big events. The sweet and warm wood smell is perfect. It makes people remember you.

products.title: Rasasi Al Wisam Day Pour Homme Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Rasasi Al Wisam Day Pour Homme Eau De Parfum is a fresh and classy men’s fragrance. It carries a clean oriental fougere scent style that feels elegant and modern at the same time. The opening starts with fresh, aromatic notes of bergamot, lavender and geranium, which gives a bright, smooth feel. The heart of the fragrance brings soft floral and woody tones of rose, sandalwood, clary sage and cedar. As the scent settles, it reveals a warm base of musk, agarwood (oud), oakmoss and amber, which gives depth and long lasting character.

products.title: Tom Ford Noir De Noir Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Tom Ford Noir De Noir Eau de Parfum is a dark, luxurious and amorous perfume among women and men. It opens with warm saffron with a little spicy touch. Gradually, the heart presents black rose and truffle that make the aroma profound, silky and somewhat earthy. Patchouli, vanilla, oud and oakmoss are used as warm and long-lasting sweeteners in the bottom. It is daring, elegant and has an evening dress.

products.title: Fragrance World Varakh Gold Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Fragrance World Varakh Gold Eau de Parfum is a luxurious and dignified perfume targeted at women who enjoy heavy and sophisticated aromas. It starts with a spicy bite of saffron and black pepper blended with fresh bergamot, and it is bold as one sprays the perfume. Gradually the odour turns warm and silky, including iris, balsam and soft woods. Its foundation is solid and lavishly oud, leather, patchouli, and sandalwood, with a long-lasting and superior touch

products.title: Chopard Black Incense Malaki Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Chopard Black Incense Malaki Eau De Parfum is a deep, smoky, and rich perfume made for both men and women. It was launched in 2020 and has a warm, mysterious scent that feels bold and elegant. The fragrance starts with spicy notes, then turns smooth with smoky resins and oud. In the end, it settles into a soft mix of leather and wood that lasts long and smells classy.

products.title: Tom Ford Tobacco Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Tom Ford Tobacco Oud Eau de Parfum is a profound, shadowy, and mighty aroma that imparts richness and smokiness. At the top, a powerful whiskey accord is the major player, giving a daring and alcoholic accent first. Gradually, spicy resins like cinnamon and coriander join in and heat things up. When it comes to the base note, the combination of tobacco and oud with incense and different types of woods results in a thick and opulent scent. This fragrance is bold, strong, and sophisticated at the same time and is made for those who like strong and adult-like perfumes.

products.title: Creed Royal Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Creed Royal Oud EDP is made for men and women. This perfume is a sophisticated perfume with a spicy and citrusy start moving into warm and woody middle notes and finishing with an elegant base. It opens with top notes of pink pepper, lemon and Sicilian bergamot which give a fresh and amazing impression. The middle notes of cedar, angelica and galbanum add a woody and green touch while the base of sandalwood, agarwood and musk leaves a smooth and long-lasting scent on skin and clothes.

products.title: Amouage  Interlude 53 Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Amouage Interlude 53 Extrait de Parfum is a rich, deep and powerful men’s fragrance from the luxury house of Amouage. It was launched in 2020 as a stronger and more intense version of the original Interlude Man. The scent opens with spicy and green notes of oregano, pimento and fresh bergamot. As it settles, the heart becomes dark and smoky with incense, amber, opoponax and labdanum. The base is heavy, warm and masculine, filled with smoke, oud, leather, patchouli and sandalwood.

products.title: Giorgio Armani Stronger With You Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Emporio Armani Stronger With You Oud is a bold and elegant men’s fragrance that combines rich oud wood with warm vanilla and soft lavender extract. It was launched in 2022. This scent is both modern and timeless, giving off strong masculine energy with a deep, smoky sweetness. It feels comforting yet powerful, perfect for men who like long-lasting, confident scents that leave an impression.

products.title: Montale Aoud Leather Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Montale Aoud Leather Eau De Parfum is a strong and bold unisex perfume that mixes rich oud with clean, warm leather. It is a deep and smooth scent that gives a powerful first impression and keeps the same strength for long hours. A mix of leather, oud, saffron, bergamot, cardamom, pepper and ambergris creates a smoky, spicy and warm smell that feels both classy and wild.

products.title: Armani Prive Rose D'arabie Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Armani Prive Rose D'arabie Eau De Parfum is a luxurious unisex perfume from Armani Prive. Launched in 2010, it is a creamy oriental floral fragrance that combines classic Middle Eastern ingredients with a modern elegance. The scent opens with fresh rose and floral notes, moves to middle notes of agarwood and patchouli, and finishes with warm vanilla for a sensual, lasting impression. It’s perfect for people who love strong, elegant, and sophisticated perfumes.

products.title: Lattafa Lattafa Al Qiam Gold Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Al Qiam Gold Eau De Parfum is a bold and creamy unisex perfume. It is made for people who like deep, warm and slightly sweet scents. The fragrance opens with a soft spicy saffron mixed with juicy raspberry, which feels smooth and classy. As it settles, the heart comes with strong leather and patchouli notes that give a dark and elegant feel. The base is long lasting with oud, amber, benzoin, guaiac wood and vetiver, creating a warm, woody and slightly smoky finish.

products.title: Parfums De Marly Haltane Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Parfums De Marly Haltane Eau De Parfum graciously accepts the entry of manly character. Its scent profile is rich, green, and woody. For sure, the first impression is the invigorating fusion of lavender, clary sage, and bergamot that radiate cleanliness and sophistication. Eventually, the warm saffron with the sweet praline take the lead, providing a soft and velvety feel. The base of oud and cedar is deep, and woody, and has the longest tenacity that is why this fragrance is beautifully bold, refined, and potent.

products.title: Riiffs Golden Elixir Extrait De Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Golden Elixir Extrait De Parfum is a creamy, warm unisex fragrance from the house of Riiffs Perfumes. It was launched in 2024 and quickly became famous for its sweet woody scent. The perfume opens with warm, spicy notes of cognac, cinnamon and nutmeg, smooth and comforting. It is sweet and fruity in the middle, with a touch of praline, plum and dates and dry, woody notes that add depth. Vanilla, tonka bean, musk and agarwood make the base creamy and warm, leaving a gentle yet distinct trail.

products.title: French Avenue Divini Aoud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Divini Aoud Eau de Parfum is a rich and bold unisex perfume made for people who love deep oriental scents. It opens fresh but slowly turns dark, warm and very luxurious. The fragrance starts with bright citrus notes, then moves into soft florals and finally settles into a heavy oud and musky base. French Avenue Divini Aoud Eau de Parfum feels classy, slightly wild and very strong in character.

products.title: Scent Story 24 Gold Oud Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Scent Story 24 Gold Oud Eau De Toilette is a bold, warm and rich unisex perfume made for people who love strong woody scents. The scent opens with the spicy notes of the hot and lively feel, then gradually intermingles with a warm and deep woodiness and increasingly comes on to a sweet, smoky oud base. The fragrance is still smooth on the skin and feels luxurious and powerful. Perfect if you are a fan of oud combined with spices and soft sweetness. Hudson Valley (50ml) brings a floral-ambery richness with rose and fruity notes, transitioning into white flowers and saffron, and finishing with deep amber, musk, and tonka bean for a warm, elegant finish.

La Luna (50ml) is an oriental, slightly sweet composition with incense, raspberry, and apricot, melting into cotton candy notes, sandalwood, and gaiac wood, ending in a comforting base of patchouli, tonka, and amberwood.
